summary: Dan's Rock lookout on Dans Mountain, Allegany County, Maryland: a 1921 station, a 15-foot tower in 1929, a 60-foot tower in 1945; NHLR (2020) says steps and cab floor and roof are gone.

facts.design: Aermotor tower with 7 by 7 foot cab (NHLR)
facts.status_note: Standing, but the NHLR says its steps have been removed and the floor and roof of the cab are missing

access.note: NHLR gives the location as Dan's Rock Overlook Park and describes the tower as missing its steps and cab floor and roof; no current visit rules were found

visit.trail_note: Wikipedia lists drive up as the easiest route to the summit

events.note: Lookout stations said to be set up on St. John's Rock and Dan's Mountain (Evening Times, quoted by Forest Lookouts)
New lookout station at Dan's Rock completed in spring 1921; telephone line and spring and fall watchman planned; cost shared by coal companies and the State Board of Forestry
15-foot steel observation tower erected on Dan's Rock in April 1929
Forest fire burned up to the base of the lookout tower in May 1939 (District Forest Warden Urner Wigfield reported)
New 60-foot steel tower replaced the 15-foot structure; announced August 4, 1945 by District Forester William H. Johnson
Registered March 24, 2020 as US 1406, MD 10; nominated by Ben Funderburg

corrections.why: The NHLR describes the standing Aermotor tower as about 70 feet (about 21.3 m). The 18.3 m figure matches the 60-foot steel tower that Forest Lookouts reports for 1945, which may not be the tower the Register describes.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The NHLR describes an Aermotor tower about 70 feet tall with a 7 by 7 foot cab. Forest Lookouts reports a 60-foot steel tower built in 1945. The sources do not say whether they describe the same structure, so the story reports both.

notes_for_editor: The NHLR gives the only description of the standing tower, and it conflicts with the 1945 60-foot steel tower in Forest Lookouts. Current condition rests on that one NHLR entry, which does not say when it was observed (its photo is dated April 2005). Access and staffing are not confirmed. The firelookout.org Maryland list (not read) also marks the tower as standing and could be checked.
